Hi Samantha — thanks for sending these over and for the clear callouts. Looping in Laura (Legal) and Ben (Sales/Commercial) to lead the review and capture any order-form impacts.

Quick answers up front:
- We support execution via the standard EU SCCs. If your legal counsel prefers the EEA addendum we can discuss but our default route is SCCs + DPA.
- For telemetry: Redwood treats model telemetry used for service reliability as Processor-held operational data; we can map the fields for the DPA exhibit and include a tech note about retention/aggregation.
- Audit notice: we typically operate on a 30-day notice for on-site/technical audits, with 90 days for formal compliance audits requiring scheduling. We can be flexible but will need to confirm timelines depending on notice type.

Laura — attaching Southbridge redlines into our Drive (link below). Can you confirm material legal objections and propose a short list of mandatory clauses we cannot accept? Ben, please flag any pricing or reserved capacity consequences if they insist on a higher SLA/audit window.

Proposed next steps:
1) Laura & team to provide an annotated response by EOD today (we'll attach Annotated_DPA_LegalNotes.pdf).
2) 30-min sync tomorrow 10:00–10:30 BST to walk the high-level items and decide whether to escalate to exec legal.
3) If Docs-signature is agreed, Ben to issue updated order form & prepare DocuSign envelope.

Rachel / team / Southbridge counsel — quick legal read & summary attached (Annotated_DPA_LegalNotes.pdf). High-level points we should push back on: 

1) Liability cap carve-outs: Southbridge has expanded categories that would effectively remove our order-form cap for broad classes of claims. Recommend pushing to a specific, narrow carve-out list (security breach, wilful misconduct).

2) SCCs vs EEA Addendum: We agree SCCs are standard. If counsel insists on the EEA addendum, that is negotiable but adds review time and requires a consent path for subprocessors in certain jurisdictions.

3) Controller/Processor split for telemetry: we need a short exhibit that lists the telemetry fields and their purpose. Laura suggests: Operational telemetry (latency/uptime) = processor; Customer-provided content (PHI in medical notes) = controller. We should include explicit language excluding customer content from our telemetry processing for model improvement unless customer opts in.

4) Audit window: 90-day notice for compliance audits is reasonable for scheduling; however, we cannot agree to on-demand access. Propose: 30 days for technical/operational checks (remotely), 90 days for compliance audits (on-site / deep-dive).

5) Retention & deletion: we need their retention profile; propose adding a table in Exhibit B (retention by data category).

I've annotated the DPA with alternatives and marked three high-risk clauses that would require Exec Legal sign-off before conceding (see pages 5, 7, 9).

Next: Ben, please advise whether accepting the 90-day compliance notice will require pricing concessions (we may need to price a dedicated compliance pack). Rachel, if Southbridge wants the EEA addendum path, flag now — that will likely add 3–4 business days of legal review.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

Hi Samantha — appreciate the quick pass. Operational questions from commercial that may affect the Order Form: 

- If you require a 90-day on-site compliance audit (with dedicated Redwood resources for remediation), that maps to our Compliance Support Add-on. Estimated uplift: +10% on committed monthly fee or a one-time professional services estimate (we can scope).
- For SCCs vs EEA addendum: if you require the EEA addendum and additional subprocessor consents, we may need to reserve a 72-hour approval SLA for subprocessor onboarding in the pilot period — this could affect go-live timing.
- Telemetry exhibit: if you want telemetry to be retained longer than our standard 30 days (e.g., 180 days), that will increase storage costs. Please confirm your target retention so I can produce an updated cost summary.

Action: Rachel — once Laura confirms the final language, I'll prepare an Order Form markup with two options (Standard / Compliance-Plus) and send a DocuSign envelope for signatures. If Southbridge is available, we can walk pricing tradeoffs on a short call.
